verdict.rationale: Wrike's own docs say it can break large goals into actionable tasks and show project schedules, which loosely covers decomposing work. Nothing in the pack documents linking dependent tasks or showing blocking order, and explicit subtask hierarchy is not named. Missing for 10: documented subtask/parent-child hierarchy, task dependency linking (e.g. finish-to-start), blocking-order visualization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear

citations.quote: Break large goals into actionable tasks, assign resources, attach files and view project schedules at a glance.
